campus_photo.description: Only a freely licensed image (Wikimedia Commons CC, CC0, public domain). Never a press photo, never a hotlinked tokenised URL. Null = no usable photo found.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, e.g. US, GB, CN, SG, CH.

institution_id.description: Must match an id in data/versions/v2/rankings.json institutions.

membership_tags.description: Only memberships the institution itself claims on its official site (e.g. Russell Group, Ivy League, C9 League, Universitas 21, AAU). Each tag carries its own official source. Never infer membership from a ranking.

name_zh.description: Verified Chinese display name where one exists (rankings.json name_zh when present). Null = none verified, never invented.

official_website.description: Canonical official domain URL. Null = not verified; never guess a domain.

stats.description: Every stat is a sourced number or null (unknown). Percentages are 0-100. student_faculty_ratio is students per staff member (e.g. 11.4 means 11.4:1). male_pct/female_pct are percentages of the student body.
